summary: A Quote subscription across a dropped socket: the reconnect subscribes the quote stream again, and a partial packet on the new socket carries only what it sent: nothing from before the outage is sent as current (the web's adapter keeps last_values across _on_open).

notes: Frames follow the INDstocks price socket's documented shape (indmoney_adapter.py:575-583: mode, instrument, timestamp in ms, data) with fractional prices so a price's JSON type is not what differs.
indmoney_adapter.py:466-511: _on_open resubscribes and never clears last_values.

deviations.reason: INDstocks sends OI as 0 when it has none (an equity's OI); the web's own get_value reads a 0 as 'nothing new' and keeps the last value, but with none to keep it sends the 0 (indmoney_adapter.py:651-665). The desktop leaves out a field with no value: a field the stream did not give a value is left out, never sent as 0 (docs; openalgo#2376; lead approval 2026-11-09).

INDstocks sends the OI change as 0 when it has none (an equity's OI); the web's own get_value reads a 0 as 'nothing new' and keeps the last value, but with none to keep it sends the 0 (indmoney_adapter.py:651-665). The desktop leaves out a field with no value: a field the stream did not give a value is left out, never sent as 0 (docs; openalgo#2376; lead approval 2026-11-09).

The web keeps last_values across a reconnect (_on_open never clears them) and sends the pre-outage value as current; the desktop starts the instrument afresh on a new connection and sends only what the new socket carried (lead decision 2026-11-09: a stale pre-outage snapshot promoted as current is a web defect).
